en: "Well now, that turned into a fine show at the very end!{w}Here's your prize money. Go on, take it."{w}
"I'll give you this too!{w}Use it with care, won't you?"{w}
note: Item given is presumably the mace Belfana offered as the bonus prize in slice 042 (3513-3517).

en: "Ahh, I feel wonderful...{w}If I soak in a hot bath after this, I'll sleep like a dream.{w}Ufufufu..."{w}

note: New key item name. [JP] = belongings left by the dead; Gregorio has just been killed in the arena (slice 042). Must match the item table.

en: "Whoa! A sharp cat punch!!{w}But the other one dodges it nya-nya style, and... a killer cat kick! No, it didn't do much!"{w}{p}"...Sigh, what the heck is this?{w}Mistress, what's gotten into you...{w}Boo hoo..."{w}
note: Cats' gender unknown: 'the other one' supplies the subject of [JP]. [JP] = 'Boo hoo...' (dejected).
Elm3 class name.

en: "I take part in these bouts to hone my skills, I do.{w}...I-it's not as if I have any interest in 3F, mind you!?"{w}
note: [JP] rendered as a light 'I do' / 'mind you' tic, not archaic English. 3F kept as in the source (the champions' route to Heerdahl 3F, row 3670).
Elm3 class name for [JP].

en: "I've got no money to buy clothes!!{w}If I win, I'll buy up every piece of clothing in the world!!{w}...Ah-choo!!"{w}
"Mistress...{w}I caught a glimpse once. If I had to compare... a black rose. S-so beautiful..."{w}
"It's warm here all year round, real easy livin', y'know."{w}
"Nooo good!{w}At this rate, I'm gonna get killed someday too!"{w}

note: [JP]; [JP] = Fighter (glossary).

en: "That damn weasel! Even my all-out blow didn't do a thing to it!!{w}...Maybe it's time I retired."{w}
note: [JP] = some weasel-like opponent; 'damn weasel' keeps the insult without gendering it.

en: "I don't care about winning at all.{w}Pro... Professor Rombino... *blush*...{w}Someday I'd love to bully the professor with my spells..."{w}
note: [JP] = blushing sound. [JP] = 'bully' (playful/teasing sense); 'the professor' avoids a pronoun for Rombino (gender unknown).

en: "Whoa-whaaat!?{w}Where's this, man!? Where are we, huh!?{w}Whaaaaa-huuuuh?"{w}
note: [JP] speech -> casual 'man', 'huh'.

en: "What is it?{w}This is a private passage for escorting the arena's champions.{w}It doesn't seem to concern you."{w}
"Congratulations on your victory.{w}From here, I can escort you to Heerdahl 3F."{w}
"...Should you need anything, you have only to ask."{w}
"Here there are souls who do not know when they died, and still wander."{w}{p}"If you were to hear their stories...{w}and speak to them in the order they died, perhaps they could be saved, but..."{w}
"It seems you have saved them.{w}They will surely rest in peace now.{w}Thank you..."{w}
"I was the first to die an honorable death in battle!{w}It's true!!"{w}

note: New name box, built on the glossary pattern (Priest's Ghost's Voice).

en: "When the two on either side of me died, I was actually casting a resurrection spell on a certain someone who died first.{w}That spell should have worked, though..."{w}{p}"Well, as for me... I got clubbed to death right after casting it."{w}
note: [JP] read as the party members on either side of the priest. [JP] kept vague ('a certain someone') as in the source - it is a puzzle clue.
New name box, glossary pattern.

en: "I bet I'm the only one in the front row who noticed."{w}{p}"That the mage at the back tripped on a rock, fell flat, took a knock on the head, got a nosebleed, and died unnoticed before the battle even began..."{w}{p}"I bet I'm the only one who noticed."{w}
note: Mage's gender not stated: phrasing avoids a pronoun. [JP] = 'quietly / without anyone knowing'. | Accuracy: [JP] = unnoticed by anyone (the puzzle clue: no one saw the mage die); "quietly" lost that.
New name box, glossary pattern.

en: "When the front line was wiped out, I suddenly got scared...{w}I tried to run before I ended up the last one left, and I died..."{w}

note: New name box, glossary pattern; 17 chars, slightly over the ~16 guideline (the glossary's own 'Alchemist's Ghost's Voice' is 25).

en: "That priest was unbelievable!{w}I was at death's door, and the priest was trying to use a resurrection spell!"{w}{p}"Surely you treat the living before someone who's already dead!"{w}{p}"I was fuming about that when the poison spread, and I keeled over and died."{w}{p}"I fell flat on my face, and right in front of me were the dead thief's feet.{w}The last thing I saw in my life was the soles of a thief's feet.{w}Poor, poor me!!"{w}
note: Priest's gender unknown: 'the priest' repeated instead of a pronoun.

en: "Wahahahaa!!{w}The first one to die? That was me, me!!{w}But the last one to die was me too!!"{w}{p}"Funny, innit?{w}How come, huh!?{w}Waaahahaha!!"{w}
note: Goofy [JP] endings -> 'innit', 'huh'.
Glossary form; 23 chars, long for a name box (in-game check).
Glossary form; 21 chars (in-game check).
Glossary form; 25 chars (in-game check).
2681/2683/2685 form one sentence across three speakers: 'In this order... we... were wiped out...'
Glossary form; 22 chars (in-game check).
Glossary form; 22 chars (in-game check).
New name box, glossary pattern; 20 chars (in-game check).

en: "See, I told you I was first!{w}Honestly, you musclehead."{w}
note: [JP] aimed at the Fighter's Ghost, who answers in 2689.

en: "A klutz who tripped and died before the fight even started gets no say!!"{w}
"Your feet are an eyesore, you know!!"{w}
note: Alchemist to the Thief (the feet from 2670); the Thief answers in 2693.

en: "Oh yeah? Sorry 'bout that!{w}Then why don't you tell me what kind of feet you'd swoon over!!"{w}
"Hey, by the way, you!{w}What was that, trying to save your own skin at the very end!"{w}
note: Aimed at the Bishop (ran away, 2667), who answers in 2699.

en: "You're short on guts, that's your problem, guts!{w}And you, magic jerk! You too..."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'magic jerk' (rude, no gender). Line is cut off in the source.

en: Making all sorts of racket as they went, they were wrapped in light and faded away, happily together...{w}

note: New name box ([JP]); 19 chars (in-game check).

en: "Tell us...{w}the order we died in...{w}Tell uuuus...!!"{w}{p}"In the order we died...{w}speak to uuus..."{w}

note: Glossary form; 20 chars (in-game check).

en: "Ah, this is a real problem...{w}Truly a deed without even the fear of the gods, you might say..."{w}{p}"Are you here hoping to get married, perhaps?{w}At the moment, you see, things are a bit...{w}A thief stole our bell, you see."{w}{p}"I'm sorry, but could you come back another time..."{w}
note: The church runs the marriage agency (glossary note). | Accuracy: [JP] -> "the gods" (polytheist setting; corpus convention), not monotheistic "God".
[JP] in hiragana = childish address; 'Mister Priest' used throughout for Analis (the priest is male per glossary). No closing punctuation in the source.

en: A Beastfolk girl appeared before you and the priest.{w}
note: [JP]: glossary 'Beastfolk Girl' (the narration says [JP], so 'girl' is in the source).

en: "Hey, hey, Mister Priest!{w}Let Analis work at this church!"{w}
note: Analis refers to self by name (as in slice 006).

en: "Yup!{w}Analis just can't find a job."{w}{p}"You'll give Analis a job, right, Mister Priest?"{w}
"Well, um...{w}Even if you put it like that...{w}You're a monster, aren't you?"{w}
"Mister Priest, your face looks like a monster's too, y'know?"{w}
